About Amazon Web Services

Amazon Web Services (AWS) offers a broad set of global compute, storage, database, analytics, application, and deployment services that help organizations move faster, lower IT costs, and scale applications. These services are trusted by the largest enterprises and the hottest start-ups to power a wide variety of workloads — including web and mobile applications, data processing and warehousing, storage, archive, and many others.

AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

The Opportunity

For a decade, WorkSpaces has been exceptional at what it was designed to do: securely deliver a virtual desktop where a user logs in, applications load, work happens, the session ends. It is reactive by design—with no memory of what occurred, no understanding of intent, and no ability to act on the user's behalf. But work has changed. The modern enterprise now runs on three workforces: humans who set direction, AI agents that execute delegated work, and the systems that run the business. Non-human identities already outnumber human ones, yet no infrastructure layer governs all three within a single trust boundary. Whoever solves this—making the secure, governed path the fastest path—will define how the world works for the next decade.

Amazon WorkSpaces is uniquely positioned to lead this transformation. We are extending its trust boundary from humans to humans and AI agents working together, governed by default. This is not an incremental improvement but a reimagining of the workspace itself—from a platform that delivers applications and compute into one that actively partners with users: understanding intent, orchestrating workflows across systems, anticipating needs, and reducing friction at every step.

We are looking for a seasoned product leader to own the end-to-end product strategy for Amazon WorkSpaces and define the future of work at the intersection of human talent and agentic AI. You will treat the workspace not as a container for compute but as the orchestration layer where humans and AI collaborate—reimagining every surface through the lens of human-AI partnership, and making AI adoption effortless for enterprises that have rightly prioritized security, governance, and compliance above all else.

Key job responsibilities
Product Vision & Strategy - Human-AI Collaboration
- Define and evangelize the product vision for Agentic WorkSpaces—the enterprise platform where humans and AI age

THE 4 BIGGEST BLOCKCHAIN STRENGTHS ARE ALSO ITS WEAKNESS

 - Permissionless nature leads to fragmentation of meaning

 - Decentralization leads to too many standards https://xkcd.com/927/

 - Immutability leads to exponential data + query infrastructure complexity

 - Neutrality means that no one is accountable for interpretations

Blockchain data is public. It is not usable at institutional scale. Despite being open, blockchain data is fragmented, hard to interpret, and painful to maintain. Even a simple question like “Who are the largest Ethereum token holders over time?” can require running nodes, ingesting full chain history, decoding contracts, cleaning edge cases, and writing complex SQL.




BLOCKCHAINS ARE OPTIMIZED FOR WRITES, NOT READS. 

They are built for consensus and execution, not searchability, standardization, or financial interpretation. Blockchains are computers, not databases https://x.com/Tim_Roughgarden/status/1512847113599729668. Every protocol defines its own schema. The same economic action can be encoded in dozens of different ways. The result:

 - Fragmented standards

 - Exponential complexity

 - No accountability for interpretation

 - Events without economic meaning

Finance cannot operate on that, it needs an effective system of record.




ALLIUM IS BUILDING THE SYSTEM OF RECORD FOR ONCHAIN FINANCE

Allium ingests, verifies, and standardizes data across 140+ blockchains and 30+ petabytes of history. We close four structural gaps that prevent blockchains from becoming systems of record:

 - Semantic Gap: Translating raw events into financial concepts like payments, trades, deposits, and staking income

 - Standardization Gap: Mapping thousands of protocols into a single canonical cross chain schema

 - Infrastructure Gap: Read optimized, globally distributed data at web scale

 - Accountability Gap: Auditable methodology, SLAs, and SOC 1 and 2 compliance

The result is a neutral, canonical data layer institutions can build on with confidence.




FINANCE IS MOVING ONCHAIN

Stablecoins, tokenized assets, trading, staking, and lending are growing rapidly. Institutions need a trusted source of truth for onchain financial activity, just as they rely on Bloomberg or DTCC in traditional markets. Raw blockchains cannot serve that role.

As AI agents begin transacting autonomously https://x.com/AlliumLabs/status/2019810793324482901?s=20, the requirement becomes even stricter. Agents cannot reason over raw event logs. They need structured data, attribution, condition checks, and auditability. 

Allium is the read layer that makes onchain finance usable for humans and machines.

Allium powers three core personas with the same canonical data foundation:

As AI accelerates software development, the need for reliable verification is only increasing. Antithesis exists to solve that problem.



We are well-funded, deeply technical, and building a category-defining platform for modern software reliability.




THE OPPORTUNITY

This is a true 0 → 1 role. You'll set the strategy, strike the deals, and get sellers on both sides working together, with real ownership and plenty of room to shape what Antithesis becomes in the ecosystem.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the AWS relationship. Build executive relationships, a joint business plan, and a clear strategy for co-sell, Marketplace, and cloud commitments.

 - Turn partnerships into pipeline. Translate integrations and joint solutions into seller playbooks, enablement, and campaigns that scale across teams and regions.

 - Set the operating rhythm. Define KPI scorecards, forecast partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, and run regular business reviews with key partners.

 - Connect the dots internally. Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and Sales to align roadmaps, launches, and events.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 6+ years in partnerships, alliances, business development, or cloud partner go-to-market

 - Hands-on experience building co-sell and joint GTM motions with AWS and other technology platforms

 - A record of generating partner-sourced pipeline and working against shared revenue targets

 - Fluency in AWS Marketplace, co-sell programs, and cloud commitments

 - The ability to turn technical capabilities into clear business value and field-ready plays

 - A builder's mindset: commercial instincts, strong communication, and comfort rolling up your sleeves

 - Willingness to travel up to 40%

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience




BONUS POINTS

We’re not slowing down, and as a result, keeping Ashby performant and reliable is a company priority. We need your leadership to do that now and in the future.

We’ve already assembled a fantastic Platform & Infrastructure team of 11 engineers (all Senior+, >70% Staff), and they’ve done an excellent job handling our growth, but the management and leadership of Platform & Infrastructure have been diffused across our Engineering leaders. As we hit our next level of scale, it’s time for us to hire an Engineering leader responsible for performance and reliability, and for building out the team that ensures those. Hopefully, that’s you!




THE ROLE

In this role, you will report directly to me, and your responsibilities will include:

 - Growing the Platform & Infrastructure team. You’ll hire ICs, managers, and build out a headcount plan. This will include determining if more specialized roles need to be established (e.g., DB Admin).

 - Building and maintaining an excellent relationship with Product Engineering. The ideal state is that Product Engineering can move incredibly fast independently without breaking performance or reliability, and Platform & Infrastructure doesn’t feel like they’re always cleaning up someone else’s “mess.” Today, there’s a great relationship, but there’s always room for improvement!

 - Assessing and improving our monitoring and incident management process. Again, we’re doing relatively well here, but there’s always room to improve. For example, making uptime measurement easier and improving coordination with Support during incidents.

 - Maintaining vendor relationships and negotiating pricing for our critical hosting and observability infrastructure, including AWS, ClickHouse, Datadog, and Braintrust. They have a meaningful impact on gross margin and need to be kept in check.

 - You’ve managed managers. Managing other leaders is a very different ball game, and not everyone enjoys it or thrives in it. Within your first 6 months, you’ll most likely have to hire a manager underneath you.

 - If you have experience managing developer experience and developer tools, building out a dedicated team for DevEx. If you don’t have experience here, DevEx will report into Product Engineering. Happy to discuss once we meet!

A big part of our secret sauce is how we run Engineering. We achieve incredible speed and quality by discarding many industry norms and being optimistic about Engineers. NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience from Google Android / Pixel, Samsung, Xiaomi, OPPO or similar Android platform teams.

 - Experience with custom ROM development.

 - Experience with Android BSP, HAL and device bring-up.

 - Experience with background execution and power optimization.

 - Experience integrating AI or ML capabilities at the OS level.

Cape is America’s privacy-first mobile carrier. Our mission is to be a force for good in global wireless. Cape was founded in 2022 by people who believe privacy is a fundamental right, not a luxury to be traded away. Our journey began when our founder recognized a critical vulnerability in our modern world: everyone relies on the same stagnant cellular infrastructure and legacy systems that track our every movement, monitor and profile our connections, and lose and sell our personal data.

Instead of accepting the status quo, we decided to fix it. National security professionals, journalists, parents, and everyone in between can stay connected and have privacy.

We didn’t just build a layer on top of old tech; we built America’s most private and secure mobile carrier from the ground up. By building our own network from scratch, we are able to design and build a suite of privacy and security features that no other carrier on the planet can offer.

Built to set the gold standard for integrated AI infrastructure

 

Crux AI is a newly formed, U.S.-based integrated AI infrastructure company created to remove the physical and operational constraints on consequential AI ambitions. Crux brings together power, high-density data centers, TPU silicon, networking, orchestration software, and ongoing operations as one integrated system.

 

Crux is being capitalized to plan every layer together, develop each one to demanding standards, and operate the whole system with efficiency and reliability. That gives hyperscalers, frontier AI labs, sovereign customers, enterprises, and AI-native companies greater freedom to pursue the AI they are here to create.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

You will own compute at Crux: the platform that turns Google TPUs, Crux power and data center capacity, and our network into dedicated, reliable, customer-ready AI compute. Reporting to our CTPO, you own everything between the rack and the customer's first job: the TPU cluster fleet, the software that provisions, monitors and heals it, the container orchestration layer that schedules work onto it, and the compute products our customers consume, from our first phase of capacity through a multi-gigawatt fleet.



This is a platform-builder seat: you will set the architecture of record, hire the leaders, and hold the bar for reliability, efficiency, and speed as Crux scales.



In this role, you will:

 - Define the compute platform strategy and architecture of record: how TPU capacity is carved into dedicated clusters, provisioned, isolated, and delivered to hyperscalers, frontier AI labs, sovereign customers, and enterprises.

 - Architect and deliver the full compute lifecycle: hardware onboarding and inventory, OS and firmware provisioning, burn-in and validation, rack certification, customer handoff, repair and retirement.

 - Design and ship Crux's managed container orchestration on bare metal: automated control-plane provisioning, upgrades, and operators for TPUs.

 - Build and lead a multi-layer engineering organization spanning cluster provisioning and lifecycle, orchestration and scheduling, fleet health and telemetry, and the customer-facing compute surface.

 - Hire people better than you at their craft, then stay close enough to know when something is off before it shows up in a report.

 - Own compute reliability and efficiency end to end: SLOs, goodput and utilization, time from rack-ready to customer-ready, and failure recovery at fleet scale, achieved through discipline, not heroics.

 - Serve as Crux's primary technical counterpart to Google on the TPU hardware, software, and services roadmap, translating customer needs into Google requirements and Google capabilities into Crux product.

 - Set the build, adopt, or integrate line for the compute software stack: what Crux builds natively, what it adopts  from Google, and what it sources from partners.

 - Stand up the security, tenant isolation, and compliance posture

At Current, everything starts with people. We partner with leading accounting firms across the United States, bringing them together through a shared platform that supports their growth while preserving the local identities and client relationships that make each firm unique. Our partner firms combine the close connections of a local team with the resources of a national community, giving professionals access to broader career opportunities, learning, collaboration, and innovative technology. Whether you join Current or one of our partner firms, you’ll be part of a connected team investing in your development and shaping the future of accounting.


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Senior Director, People Technology leads the transformation of Current’s people systems, data, and processes across a rapidly growing, acquisition-driven organization. This leader owns people data and governance and is accountable for establishing reliable employee data, developing consistent processes across firms, and designing, building, and launching Rippling to replace UKG. Working across Human Capital, Payroll, Finance, Technology, Data, and acquired firms, this role owns implementation outcomes and builds the team, governance, and technology roadmap needed to support Current’s continued growth.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Lead the UKG-to-Rippling implementation, including design, data migration, testing, change management, cutover, stabilization, and UKG retirement.

 - Own program governance, milestones, risks, budget, vendor performance, executive updates, and cross-functional decisions.

Form Energy is hiring a Director of Supplier Industrialization Engineering and Quality to build and lead the team responsible for the technical relationship with our supplier base, from first sketch through high-volume production, and for the quality systems that ensure everything that arrives at our factories meets spec. The Strategic Finance team is responsible for shaping the company’s financial strategy and plays a critical role in capital allocation decisions to align financial goals with broader business and mission objectives.

About the Role

The Head of Data Science, Strategic Finance will partner closely with the rest of the Strategic Finance team as well as the Product and GTM Data Science organizations to execute on core business priorities. You will report to the VP of Strategic Finance and work closely with finance leadership to drive data driven decision-making, improve data fluency of those around you, and move the needle on financial outcomes. This is a managerial role. 

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Develop accurate forecasts for product usage and revenue, compute consumption and their underlying drivers, allowing for real-time tracking of key metrics performance and trajectory.

 - Become an expert in OAI’s data and systems, through partnership with Data Engineering, Finance, and other Data Science teams.

 - Design and deliver dashboards for key metrics that impact financial performance.

 - Lead metrics reviews with Strategic Finance and finance leadership to interpret trends from aforementioned dashboards and surface actionable insights.

 - Drive automation of standardized reporting, analysis, and processes across our various revenue segments and compute spend.

 - Build and mentor a high-performing team.

 - Support critical business decisions with ad hoc analysis as needed.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - A MS/PhD in a quantitative discipline (Math, Statistics, Operations Research, Economics, Engineering, or CS).

 - 12+ years of experience in a Data Science role at a dynamic and outcome-driven organization.

 - Proficiency in critical analytical tools including SQL.

 - Extensive experience building production-ready models for time series applications.

 - Built adjustable and explainable forecast models for multiple planning cycles.

 - Experience conducting open-ended research projects on new forecasting methodologies.

 - Exemplary ability to distill complex financial information into actionable insights for leadership.

 - Excellent communication skills and “storytelling” ability when presenting data insights.

 - The ability to thrive in a dynamic environment. That means being flexible and willing to jump in and do whatever it takes to be successful.

 - Knowledge of Python.

 - Prior management experience.

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market. Engineering here is small, senior, and close to the business: the systems you build move real money under real regulatory obligations.

We're hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the teams that move, clear, and protect customer funds on Polymarket US. MAKING THE METALS POWERING THE WORLD

Solcoa is building the next generation of American metalmaking, starting with rare earths — the metals of power and motion. We've developed a new chemistry that converts rare earth oxides into high-purity metals — the materials inside every EV, fighter jet, wind turbine, and data center — cleaner, cheaper, and faster than any conventional process. Now we're scaling it to thousands of tonnes of annual production.

 


THE ROLE

Head of Engineering will lead Solcoa's Engineering team with the goal of developing and scaling up novel rare earth metal production processes. You will own a full metal production development program. This includes development starting from research, process development, and full scale reactor design. You will also own the engineering, construction, and commissioning of Solcoa’s first commercial facility.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Process Design. Own the design of the metal production process that will bring metal production to cost parity with China. In this capacity, you will identify bottlenecks and radically simplify Solcoa’s process.

 - Reactor Design. You will lead the design and engineering of the modular high-temperature metallothermic reduction reactors capable of producing rare earths at high yield and high throughput. You will organize the research, simulations, and mechanical engineering teams for the engineering and fabrication of it.

 - Solcoa One, Process Design. You will identify key requirements, milestones, and be responsible for the delivery of the operating process at Solcoa One, our first commercial metal production plant. Head of Engineering will lead the process engineering team, responsible for designing the process and balancing of the plant. You will work with the Head of Capital Projects to engineer, staff, commission, and ramp up the largest rare earth metal production plant in the United States.

 - Organization. You will define weekly goals and long-term milestones for the individual contributors on the research team, process development team, and mechanical engineering team. You will identify hiring needs and capital budget needs for achieving the metal capacity goals set by Solcoa’s leadership. You participate in the major decisions that define the direction of Solcoa’s metal production business.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Competitive base salary.

 - Generous stock options.

 - Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance.

 - Company-provided lunch daily.

 - Visa sponsorship available if needed.

ABM (NYSE: ABM) is a leading provider of facility solutions with revenues of approximately $8.7 billion and over 130,000 employees in 300+ offices deployed throughout the United States and various international locations. ABM’s comprehensive capabilities include electrical & lighting, energy solutions, facilities engineering, HVAC & mechanical, janitorial, landscape & turf, mission critical solutions and parking, provided through stand-alone or integrated solutions.

Reporting directly to the SVP & CISO, the Director, AI Security Enablement will build and lead ABM's enterprise AI security strategy to include imbedding security into artificial intelligence, machine learning, and agentic AI across the business, spanning ABM’s AI security tooling, internal AI/ML development, and third-party AI products and vendors. This leader designs and champions the guardrails, governance, and technical controls that allow ABM to adopt AI and agentic AI capabilities quickly and confidently, while protecting the business, its customers, and its employees from the emerging risks these technologies introduce.

The role carries direct people-leadership responsibility, building and developing a team of approximately three AI/ML security specialists, and also requires strong matrix-management skills to coordinate and drive security outcomes through engineers, developers, data scientists, and vendor teams who do not report directly to this role. Highly organized program and stakeholder management is essential: this leader will run multiple concurrent security-enablement initiatives across internal development teams and third-party AI vendors, track them to completion, and communicate progress clearly to technical teams, business stakeholders and executive leadership.

The Director, AI Security Enablement must have hands-on depth in both traditional cybersecurity and modern AI security — including large language models (LLMs), generative AI, and agentic AI architectures where autonomous or semi-autonomous agents take actions, call tools, and access systems and data on behalf of users or other systems.

This role will establish cross-functional partnerships across Security, Engineering, Data Science & AI/ML teams, Legal, Risk, Privacy, and Operations to enable innovation while protecting the organization from emerging AI risks.

**ADP is hiring a Director, Enterprise Learning Platforms.**

* *Do you thrive at the intersection of product management, platform strategy, and learner experience?*
* *Are you passionate about delivering intelligent, scalable learning experiences for associates and clients worldwide?*
* *Are you ready to lead the evolution of ADP’s Enterprise Learning ecosystem - including AI powered learning?*

Well, this may be the role for you. Ready to make your mark?

As Director, Enterprise Learning Platforms, you will serve as the enterprise product management leader for the platforms and applications that enable ADP to deliver learning experiences to associates, clients, and consumers. The ecosystem includes our LMSs, internally developed applications, learner-facing AI technologies, and integrated technologies such as survey tools, virtual learning platforms, e-commerce, and collaboration tools.

You will serve as the enterprise owner of learning platform ecosystem and learner-facing AI technologies, defining direction and priorities, while partnering closely with leaders across the learning organization. You will lead platform analysis, governance execution, vendor coordination, and continuous improvement.

You will partner closely with the Learning Support and Learning Technology teams, which own configuration and engineering delivery, including integrations and automations for learning platforms. While development teams do not report into this role, you will operate in a matrixed model, providing product direction, requirements, prioritization, and governance to ensure delivery aligns with enterprise learning strategy and platform outcomes.

This role is accountable for ensuring ADP’s learning ecosystem is scalable, compliant, data-driven, and future-ready, supporting best-in-class learning experiences for associates, clients, and consumers across all regions and business units.

Like what you see? **Apply now!**

**Learn more about ADP at jobs.adp.com**

**What you’ll do:**

**Here’s what you can expect on a typical day:**

**Platform Strategy & Ownership**

* Define and lead the enterprise roadmap for ADP’s third-party learning platforms, and internally developed applications aligned with business priorities and global learning needs.
* Set the long-term vision for the learning ecosystem, including ecosystem expansion, and emerging technology adoption.
* Ensure consistency, scalability, and alignment across all LMS instances and integrated platforms.

**Product Management & Business Partnership**

* Lead intake, prioritization, and roadmap planning in partnership with Learning Operations, Instructional Design, Learning Delivery, and Business Unit Learning Leaders.
* Lead continuous discovery to understand learner, administrator, facilitator, and business needs and translate them into opportunities.
* Own portfolio prioritization and investment recommendations, including when to build, buy, integrate, consolidate, enhance, or retire capabilities.
*

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

About Amazon Web Services
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) offers a broad set of global compute, storage, database, analytics, application, and deployment services that help organizations move faster, lower IT costs, and scale applications. These services are trusted by the largest enterprises and the hottest start-ups to power a wide variety of workloads — including web and mobile applications, data processing and warehousing, storage, archive, and many others.
  
  
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
For a decade, WorkSpaces has been exceptional at what it was designed to do: securely deliver a virtual desktop where a user logs in, applications load, work happens, the session ends. It is reactive by design—with no memory of what occurred, no understanding of intent, and no ability to act on the user's behalf. But work has changed. The modern enterprise now runs on three workforces: humans who set direction, AI agents that execute delegated work, and the systems that run the business. Non-human identities already outnumber human ones, yet no infrastructure layer governs all three within a single trust boundary. Whoever solves this—making the secure, governed path the fastest path—will define how the world works for the next decade.
  
  
Amazon WorkSpaces is uniquely positioned to lead this transformation. We are extending its trust boundary from humans to humans and AI agents working together, governed by default. This is not an incremental improvement but a reimagining of the workspace itself—from a platform that delivers applications and compute into one that actively partners with users: understanding intent, orchestrating workflows across systems, anticipating needs, and reducing friction at every step.
  
  
We are looking for a seasoned product leader to own the end-to-end product strategy for Amazon WorkSpaces and define the future of work at the intersection of human talent and agentic AI. You will treat the workspace not as a container for compute but as the orchestration layer where humans and AI collaborate—reimagining every surface through the lens of human-AI partnership, and making AI adoption effortless for enterprises that have rightly prioritized security, governance, and compliance above all else.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Product Vision & Strategy - Human-AI Collaboration

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

The duty of this organization is to enable our Customers' ongoing Mission Readiness. From the moment they say "go" until the contract is fulfilled. We are only successful when the customer's mission is successful.  
  
Mission Readiness is the post-production shared services organization for Anduril. This team supports the Business Lines and Divisions throughout the lifecycle of their product, from initial sustainment concept through delivery, installation, operation, repair and return. These service offerings also include providing technical publications, training, customer support, connectivity services and other value-added services. To the degree the Business elects, we accept the delegated responsibility for upfront and continued delivery of the committed service solutions. This team endeavors to provide the Business Lines, as our internal customers, shared mission services that are more efficient and cost effective than if they chose to provide them directly. By offering mission support capabilities and capacity that are not "core" to the Business, the Business can focus resources on addressing the next big need while we ensure existing commitments are met.  
  
As Anduril's installed base grows across an increasing number of products and Business Lines, our MRO organization needs to move from a collection of program-specific repair processes and tools to a hardened, scalable operating model. This role is about leading that shift.

### **ABOUT THE JOB**

We are looking for a Director of MRO Transformation to lead the modernization and scaling of Anduril's repair operations. Where our Head of MRO oversees the collective repair function, this Director role owns the transformation agenda: establishing core processes for any Business Line to leverage, selecting and implementing the tools and systems MRO runs on, and driving the change management needed to get a fast-growing collection of programs onto common, scalable rails. You will assess where today's pockets of good activity exist, build the roadmap to modernize them, and lead cross-functional teams through the change without slowing down repair turnaround for products already in the field. That mindset led Apple to pioneer Private Cloud Compute and to deploy differential privacy at scale, and it continues to raise the bar for what privacy engineering can achieve. As a leading provider of gaming content and technology, we craft the future of the gaming industry with our innovative products and world-class team. Join us as the Senior Director, AI Products & Enablement. Lead a small but mighty team to turn AI capabilities into scalable business workflows that drive measurable value. This is an outstanding opportunity to be at the forefront of redefining work through AI. Work closely with leaders across the globe to ensure our AI initiatives deliver significant business impact.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

* Lead the Gaming AI and intelligent-automation portfolio, including opportunity intake, prioritization, investment recommendations, and executive reporting to the Gaming leadership team.
* Own the AI workflow-product lifecycle and stage gates (Frame, Build, Prove, Scale, Realize, Evolve), making evidence-based recommendations to scale, remediate, transfer, or retire each product.
* Deliver the first two major Quote-to-Cash AI products, passionate about first-time-right order entry and invoice accuracy and explainability, with seller efficiency as a cross-cutting outcome.
* Ensure every material product has a named business benefit owner, a measurable baseline, an adoption plan, and Finance-validated benefits before it scales.
* Manage the cadence for workflow economics, AgentOps, capacity reinvestment, and workforce-readiness reviews, measuring value at the completed-work level rather than by hours saved or token cost alone.
* Establish Scrum rigor and delivery rhythm during the team's formation, and lead enterprise dependencies across Group AI, Group IT, Enterprise Data, and functional process owners.
* Partner with Group IT to maintain architecture standards, security, production environments, and reliability with Technology, and with Group AI to align to enterprise policy, approved platforms, and responsible-AI standards.
* Collaborate with HR and business leaders on human-AI work development, defining which tasks are human-led, AI-assisted, or AI-executed, and on fair, clear workforce transitions.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing, globally distributed team, setting clear goals, accountability, and a culture of measurable outcomes over technology novelty.

**What We're Looking For**

### **Location: US, Remote (Eastern Hours)**

### **About BOI**

BOI is the AI partner that Walmart, Coca-Cola, and Mastercard call when AI needs to drive growth, not just savings. We rebuild how work gets done, starting from the outcomes each team exists to deliver: agents do the work, people own the judgment, and the capacity it frees goes to growth. We bring together the unusually strong in frontier enterprise AI, then give them the ownership to make it happen. If you're looking for a comfortable place to hide, we're not it. If you want to build the future of enterprise AI with people who will make you better: welcome home.

### **Your Role**

### **Own the Technical Build**

* Own the architecture and engineering quality of every client build, from first prototype to production in the client's environment.
* Shape solution architecture across models, clouds and platforms, and make build, buy or configure calls you can defend to a client CTO. Our clients run on Azure, AWS and Google Cloud. We're independent of every vendor, so the answer is whatever is best for the client.
* Set the engineering standards every build meets: evaluation of AI outputs, security and data governance, observability, and production reliability.
* Build the reusable components, patterns and internal products that let each engagement start further ahead than the last.

### **Lead with Clients**

* Sit with client CTOs, CIOs and business executives as BOI's senior technical voice. Explain technical choices in terms of cost, risk and value, so non-technical leaders can decide.
* Lead client security, compliance and procurement reviews, and get our systems approved to run in their environments.
* Work forward deployed: get into client environments early, build alongside their teams, and keep building as the relationship grows.

### **Shape What We Sell**

* Scope and estimate builds for proposals with our Directors of Applied AI, so what we sell can be built on time and to standard.
* Turn what we've built into case studies, reusable IP and technical thought leadership.

### **Build the Team**

* Lead, coach and grow our engineering team, roughly doubling it over the next year. Set high standards, give direct feedback, and give credit generously.
* Run AI-first ways of working across engineering, with your own tools and workflows as the example.
* Help build BOI like an owner, alongside our leadership team in the US and Europe.

We are deliberately not for everyone. We look for a specific combination of qualities:

* You've shipped AI systems to production at enterprise scale, inside environments with real security, compliance and data constraints.
* You've led engineering in a consultancy, agency or other project-based environment. You're comfortable with work that changes shape every few months and with stacks you didn't choose.

ABOUT THE CAMPAIGN FINANCE BOARD
  
  
The Campaign Finance Board is a nonpartisan, independent city agency that empowers New Yorkers to have a greater impact on their elections. Our mission is to make local democracy more open, transparent, and equitable by removing barriers to participation.
  
  
We make it easier for New Yorkers to vote, meaningfully support candidates for city office, and run for office themselves. NYC Votes, our voter engagement initiative, meets people where they are to share trustworthy election information and help New Yorkers make a plan to vote. We publish the citywide Voter Guide, which delivers information about candidates directly to voters’ doors. Our public matching funds program ensures small contributions can make a big difference, allowing regular people to run for office by relying on the support of other regular people, not just wealthy donors and special interests. And we lift the veil on how candidates raise and spend money, increasing transparency and accountability in local government.
  
  
We believe that when every New Yorker is empowered to participate meaningfully in elections, candidates will better reflect the communities they serve, elected leaders will be more accountable to the public, and New Yorkers will have a democracy they can truly trust.
  
  
ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT
  
  
The Strategy, Products, and Innovation division leads the agency’s strategic planning and policy work, partnering across the agency to test and implement new ideas. The division also develops and delivers the agency’s product roadmap, maintaining and modernizing the systems that support our work in future elections.
  
  
The new Data department will ensure that the agency’s information is trustworthy, well governed, protected, and ready to use. As the agency moves to a modern cloud platform and data lakehouse and explores responsible uses of AI, the department will set the standards for how data is classified, managed, and maintained. It will bring together data governance, privacy, records management, open data, and AI assurance, and work closely with engineering teams, which build to these standards, and with staff across the agency who rely on data to do their work.
  
  
The department will be built in phases. In the near term, the Senior Director of Data will welcome the Records, Data & Information unit into the department, establish the data governance program alongside the agency’s cloud migration, and build strong workflows across these disciplines. Over the next few years, the department will grow to include a data science capability that supports the agency’s mission and strategic goals.

We recently completed a private placement financing and Alternative Public Offering and are now operating as a public company while maintaining our startup agility and innovation focus. With strategic partnerships in place, strong private and public investment, and active engagement with the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC), we are executing our next phase of growth as we advance our groundbreaking nuclear technology toward commercial deployment.

Deep Fission is seeking a VP of Engineering to build and lead the technical organization responsible for taking our borehole reactor design from concept to repeatable commercial deployment. Edible Brands® was launched in 2022 to bring together powerful, purpose-led brands under one unified purpose: to enrich everyday life through celebration, nourishment, and wellness. Today, Edible Brands powers three bold and growing concepts across 600+ locations worldwide.

Our portfolio spans Edible Arrangements®, the iconic gifting brand; Rōti®, a Mediterranean-inspired fast-casual restaurant; and BerryDirect®, our robust supply chain infrastructure. As the Director, Marketplace Strategy & Business Development, you will be responsible for expanding how and where customers discover, purchase, and experience Edible Brands. We are a forward-thinking electric utility powered by a diverse team of employees committed to making customers’ lives brighter, the environment better and our communities stronger.

This is a people-leadership role accountable for vulnerability remediation, reliability (SLA, SLO, and SLI), automation and toil reduction, vendor management, defect management, legacy lifecycle and sunsetting, and resilience and continuity including on-call and disaster recovery. This person will lead a team of operations and application engineers and set the operational discipline for the portfolio.

**Job Description**
===================

**Why This Role Exists**

DSCX owns 30+ digital products for Defense & Systems. Today our technical product managers wear three hats for their products: product management, project management, and operations. We are dividing that load across three dedicated functions, and this role will build out the operations discipline, consolidating ticket management, software hygiene, patching, and vulnerability closure into a single team. This role is planned to have 6-8 direct reports, and the portfolio includes many legacy applications and reports that need to be retired, rewritten, or absorbed into our AI product vision. Your charge is to standardize processes and artifacts, build automation that removes the manual work, and then coach and train your team to hold it. The DSCX portfolio runs primarily on AWS, Palantir Foundry, or through SaaS based 3rd party solutions, with on-premise implementations supported for customers whose data sensitivity requires it. Delivery runs through Rally and Microsoft Teams and ServiceNow is our system of record for incident, change, and defect management. Monitoring and alerting tooling varies by application across the portfolio, and consolidating it is part of this team's work. Helius is a leading developer platform on the Solana blockchain, dedicated to inspiring and accelerating the creation of crypto-powered software. Customers like Coinbase, Jupiter, and Phantom use Helius to power their applications on Solana.

Karman is a fast-growing NVIDIA-backed AI company enabling AI data centers to dynamically orchestrate power and unlock more compute capacity from existing energy infrastructure. For over a decade, we have applied AI to the electric grid, bringing real-time visibility and power-flow control to complex energy infrastructure. Our Karman platform, built on a custom NVIDIA module, brings that same capability to AI data centers, giving operators a way to better use the power already available to them.  
  
**The team**  
The Power Applications team takes power orchestration algorithms from idea to production. We develop, ship, and maintain the applications that run on Karman to solve power management problems and orchestrate control actions in real time in megawatt-scale data centers. We own the decision layer of Karman’s real-time control loop: turning live power telemetry into power management commands fast enough to keep data centers safe and fully utilized.  
  
Our scope requires us to blend research and development with continuous delivery. The team is a mix of data scientists, algorithms engineers, software engineers, and AI infrastructure engineers, organized into two complementary groups. Research and development proves and matures new control, estimation, and forecasting capabilities and builds the evidence to decide what moves into the product. Continuous delivery turns that validated theory into reliable, deployable software and keeps it performing in the field.  
  
**The role**  
The Director, Power Applications leads this team and owns its outcomes on both workflows, reporting to the VP of AI and Applications.  
  
The job sits at the interface between research and implementation. On one side you lead scientists and senior algorithms engineers working on open problems, where the hardest questions are how to interpret, prioritize, and resource work with ambiguous scope, and when to pivot, double down, or shelve. On the other side you lead principal-level software engineers shipping control software with hard reliability guarantees against committed product dates. Your job is to make those two sides one program: research framed so that it produces decisions on time, results that move into production as deliberate increments, and field performance that feeds the next research question.  
  
You are also the team's single point of contact for planning and reporting. You partner with Product and technical program management on roadmap commitments, keep the technical roadmap visible alongside the product roadmap, and make the trade-offs between delivery, research, and requests for proof points and demonstrations explicit, with their costs stated. **Description**

The Homeland Sector operates across some of the world's most consequential transportation, security, infrastructure and government missions.

Its portfolio spans air traffic management, airports and borders, security screening, energy and critical infrastructure, and substantial businesses in the United States, United Kingdom and Australia. Across these markets, customers are modernizing long-lived operational systems while adopting software, data, AI and other rapidly evolving technologies.

Technology must therefore do more than support individual programs. It must help shape where Homeland competes, how it grows, what it invests in and how it improves execution.

The Homeland Sector CTO is responsible for making that happen.

This is an enterprise business and technology leadership role. The CTO helps shape business and portfolio strategy, engages customers before requirements are fixed, creates technology-enabled growth opportunities, strengthens major pursuits and execution, and builds the technical leadership and capabilities required for Homeland's future.

As a member of the Corporate CTO organization and the senior technology executive for Homeland, this leader connects enterprise technology strategy and capabilities with the customer, market and delivery needs of the Sector.

The opportunity is to help lead and change the Homeland business using technology as a principal lever for growth, differentiation, speed and performance.

Position Summary

The Chief Technology Officer of the Homeland Sector is responsible for shaping how technology advances the Sector's strategy, growth, delivery, investment priorities and future portfolio.

  

The CTO reports to the Leidos Corporate CTO, with a dotted-line reporting relationship to the Homeland Sector President. The Corporate CTO owns enterprise technology strategy, architecture, standards and enterprise capabilities. The Homeland Sector President owns Sector business strategy and outcomes. The Homeland CTO is accountable for integrating those agendas and for technology outcomes across the Homeland business.

The CTO serves as both a senior leader within Corporate Technology and a member of the Homeland Sector executive leadership team. The role directly leads the Homeland technology organization, including the Business Area CTOs and cross-sector technical leaders, and works closely with Business Area presidents, Growth, Operations and corporate technology organizations.

The role creates value in both directions: bringing relevant Leidos technologies, platforms, talent and investment into Homeland while ensuring Homeland's customer needs, technologies and market insights help shape the broader Leidos technology agenda.

The mandate is not to impose common technology for its own sake. It is to create leverage where shared platforms, capabilities, talent and investment provide real advantage while preserving the domain expertise and flexibility required by distinct businesses.

The Director will move the organization from fragmented, vendor-specific, and manually driven prioritization toward an enterprise-owned approach to risk adjustment decisioning and orchestration. The role will oversee how opportunities are identified, deduplicated, economically prioritized, routed to the appropriate execution engine, and measured through completion.
  
  
Sitting within Clinical Technology, this leader will partner closely with Risk Adjustment, Clinical, Coding, Operations, Product, Engineering, Data & Analytics, Finance, and market leadership.  
  
The Director will also serve as a senior product and technology partner to external vendors, ensuring that platforms such as Navina operate as execution engines within Mosaic’s broader enterprise strategy rather than independently defining prioritization and workflow
  
  
The successful candidate will combine expertise in risk adjustment, healthcare product management, clinical technology, data, workflow design, and value-based care economics.

‎

‎

**Strategic Leadership**

  

* Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and operating model for Mosaic’s enterprise risk adjustment technology capabilities.
* Lead development and maturation of the Burden of Illness Hub as the central orchestration capability for risk adjustment and related clinical opportunities.

----------------

Most people with treatment-resistant depression, PTSD, or OCD spend years cycling through medications before anyone mentions there are other options. Treatments like accelerated TMS, SAINT, Spravato, and IV ketamine can work when nothing else has. They're also hard to find, hard to get covered, and hard to deliver well. That gap is why Radial exists.

We support the country's largest network of brain medicine clinics: 27 clinics and more than 100 clinicians across seven states, caring for patients with some of the most serious mental health conditions there are. RadialOS, our AI-native operating system, matches patients to the right treatment, coordinates their care, and takes administrative work off clinicians' plates. We're backed by General Catalyst, and in 2026 we acquired the MSO behind Mindful Health Solutions, one of the pioneers of interventional psychiatry.

Every role here supports our mission of getting patients access to the care they need as quickly as possible.

**What is the opportunity?**
----------------------------

We are seeking a Senior Technologist to lead the design and implementation of an ultra-low-latency electronic trading platform targeting microsecond and sub-microsecond latencies. This role requires deep expertise across multiple domains: protocol design, distributed systems, market data infrastructure, hardware acceleration, and operational resilience. The successful candidate will own the technical strategy, establish engineering standards, and ensure the stack meets aggressive latency targets while maintaining deterministic failover capabilities and production reliability.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

* **Architecture & Protocol Design:** Design the foundational messaging layer, evaluating trade-offs between FIX and Simple Binary Encoding (for internal components).
* **FPGA & Hardware Acceleration Strategy:** Evaluate and architect FPGA-based acceleration for latency-critical paths. This includes market data feed parsing, order matching logic, risk checks, and order routing decisions. You will define which components warrant FPGA implementation based on latency budgets, throughput requirements, and cost trade-offs. You will work with vendors such as Exegy, Redline, et al. and establish FPGA trading components.
* **Kernel Bypass & OS-Level Optimization:** Architect the system to bypass the kernel network stack entirely using technologies like DPDK (Data Plane Development Kit), Open Onload, or similar kernel-bypass frameworks. You will establish CPU affinity and isolation strategies, including CPU pinning, isolcpus kernel parameter configuration, and NUMA optimization for multi-socket systems.
* **Sequencer & Event Stream Design:** Architect the sequencer component that creates deterministic, replayable event streams with minimal latency overhead. This includes designing the durability model (persisted to ultra-low-latency storage, replicated over high-speed networks), defining sequence numbering schemes, and establishing how the sequencer handles clock skew, network partitions, and replica synchronization. You must ensure that the sequenced stream enables stateless recovery of replicas without introducing bottlenecks.
* **Ultra-Low-Latency Market Data Infrastructure:** Design the market data ingestion layer targeting microsecond-scale processing. This includes evaluating direct feeds (multicast feeds from exchanges), FPGA-based feed parsing, and kernel-bypass software processing. **About Runware**
-----------------

Runware is the AI inference platform that builds and operates its own infrastructure, end to end. One API gives developers access to image, video, audio, 3D and language models, and our Sonic Inference Engine runs them on hardware we designed ourselves: custom servers, custom boards and a closed-loop, water-free cooling system, packed into Sonic Inference Pods — roughly 1 MW of liquid-cooled GPU compute in a 20-foot container that can be sited wherever power is cheap and available.

This is why infrastructure at Runware is the product, not a cost center. Our edge is that we run inference 30–90% cheaper per GPU-hour than our peers, and that edge is earned in the data center: in how fast we can stand up a new site, how tightly we run our fleet, and how little downtime our customers ever see. More than 20 billion requests have run through the platform for over a million developers, with customers such as Wix, Quora, Freepik and Higgsfield building production applications on top of it.

We raised a $50M Series A led by Dawn Capital, with Comcast Ventures, Speedinvest, Insight Partners and a16z speedrun participating, and we are now building out a global network of pods across the US and Europe. We need someone to own how that network is operated.

**The role**
------------

As Head of Infrastructure Operations, you'll own the physical and operational backbone of Runware: the servers, storage and networking across every site we run, and the team that keeps them running. You'll take us from a handful of pods to a global fleet, and you'll decide how that fleet is built, provisioned, monitored, maintained and scaled.

**The Opportunity**

  

Join TE Connectivity's fast-growing Optics organization and lead the team that designs and delivers precision manufacturing equipment for next-generation optical connectivity. This position will lead a unique disruptive manufacturing equipment that is solving the core performance and scalability challenges of CPO. Reporting to the VP and General Manager of Optics, you will lead the engineering organization that builds TE's proprietary precision assembly stations, with teams across machine architecture, precision mechanics and optomechanics, motion, robotics, controls, software, vision, sensing, metrology, tooling, integration, and commissioning.

  

Own the full lifecycle of TE's internal precision stations - from architecture through design, build, validation, release, global replication, ramp, and continuous improvement. Your organization works as an internal station supplier to the manufacturing process team that industrializes the full cable assembly line. Product, process, equipment, test, quality, and operations teams co-develop from the earliest experiments through high-volume production.

  

**Why This Role Matters**

  

TE is scaling fiber-array assemblies, micro-optics, fiber-to-chip interfaces, optical connectors, and other advanced optical-packaging products. **WHO WE ARE**

The Estate Lawyers is a growing estate planning and administration firm built on a simple belief: families deserve clear guidance and exceptional service during some of the most important moments of their lives. We take that seriously — in how we practice law, how we treat each other, and how we build our firm.

We operate on EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System), which means we run on clear priorities, honest conversations, and measurable results. Our core values aren't wall décor — they show up in how we make decisions, how we hold each other accountable, and who we hire.

We're at an inflection point. The firm is growing — in clients, in people, and in locations — and we need the operational foundation to match. That's why this role exists.

**ABOUT THIS ROLE**

This is a builder role for a firm that is ready to scale.

As Director of Operations & Technology, you own the roadmap for how this firm grows — operationally, technologically, and structurally. You identify what's holding us back before it becomes a problem, design the fix, and see it through to measurable results.

You sit on the Leadership Team and report directly to the CEO/Integrator. You're not here to coordinate for other leaders — you're here to raise the standard of how the whole firm operates, and you have the authority to do it.

This role is right for someone who wants real accountability, not just responsibility. You will assess, prioritize, build, and measure. If something isn't working, you'll say so — and fix it.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**

You're drawn to complexity, not intimidated by it. You see operational gaps as problems worth solving, not someone else's mess to manage.

You set a high bar — for yourself and for the work around you. You don't need consensus to move, but you know how to bring people with you. You communicate directly and earn trust through follow-through, not charm.

You think in systems. When something breaks, you don't just fix the symptom — you find the pattern and design the solution that holds. You're comfortable presenting a recommendation to leadership and defending it with evidence.

You've built operational infrastructure before. You know what a 12-month roadmap looks like when it's real versus vanity metrics. You can evaluate a technology investment in business terms and explain your reasoning to someone who isn't technical.

You don't need the spotlight. You need the work to be right.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Build and Maintain the Operations and Technology Roadmap**

* Regularly assess the firm's operations with department leaders — staffing, processes, software, reporting, office infrastructure, and capacity gaps.
* Build and maintain written 12–24 month roadmap: each initiative states the problem, expected benefit, proposed owner, estimated cost, dependencies, and timing.
* Rank priorities by client impact, employee impact, cost, risk, and growth needs. Recommend what to approve now, defer, or stop.
* Review the roadmap

**Chief Technology Officer, x402 Foundation**
---------------------------------------------

### **Company Description**

The Linux Foundation is a 501(c)(6) non-profit that provides a neutral, trusted hub for developers and organizations to code, manage, and scale open technology projects and ecosystems.

The x402 Foundation is the vendor-neutral home of the x402 protocol, an open standard that embeds payments directly into web interactions. Built on the HTTP 402 "Payment Required" status code, x402 lets AI agents, APIs, and applications exchange value as easily as they exchange data. The Linux Foundation launched the x402 Foundation in April 2026. Together with a broad community of payment networks, cloud providers, and developers, we are building an open, interoperable payments layer for the internet.

In this position, you will be the technical representative of the Executive Director and a key technical voice to members, maintainers, and external standards bodies. You will publish the projected x402 technical roadmap, stand up the conformance program, and drive integrations with adjacent protocols so that x402 works across the agentic and web payments ecosystem.

You will work directly alongside the Executive Director, foundation staff, Technical Steering Committee, Working Group chairs, and protocol maintainers to set technical direction, track progress against goals, and report on project health and spec adoption.

UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.  
  
Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.  
  
UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

**About the role**
------------------

We're looking for a Director of Mission Operations to build and lead the team that delivers UFORCE's uncrewed systems missions. You'll own the operational portfolio across the customer lifecycle: pre-sale demonstrations, events and exercises, as well as post-sale deployments and customer implementations.

Reporting to the VP of Delivery, you'll lead and develop our Mission Managers, establish the standards and decision-making practices for safe, repeatable execution, and make sure concurrent missions have the people, equipment and support they need. You'll work closely with the Director of Training, who provides training personnel, pilots and field deployment engineers, and the Director of Operations, who supplies equipment, products and logistics.

This is a hands-on leadership role, but not one where you'll personally run every mission. You'll deploy when it matters—on first-of-kind, high-risk or high-visibility missions, or to coach and assess your team—while building an operation that succeeds through capable mission leaders.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own the mission portfolio across demonstrations, exercises, deployments and customer implementations. Maintain a clear view of upcoming work, mission ownership, staffing, assets, readiness and risk.
* Review new opportunities for operational feasibility, capacity and risk before commitments are made. Resolve competing demands where you can, and bring recommended trade-offs to leadership when needed.
* Lead, hire and develop Mission Managers. Establish clear expectations, a structured qualification path, regular feedback and backup coverage, while managing deployment tempo and fatigue.
* Set and maintain practical mission standards, including planning templates, risk assessments, readiness reviews, briefs, communications plans and closeout reports. Check that they work in the field and improve them as the team learns.
* Establish clear decision and escalation boundaries with leadership and the appropriate technical and safety owners. Make it safe and expected for the team to raise concerns and pause or stop a mission.
* Work with the Director of Training to secure qualified personnel and with the Director of Operations to secure platforms, equipment, logistics and support. Set clear requirements and lead assigned personnel during mission execution

For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer.

Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations.

If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer!

Position Summary:

The Senior Director of Production serves as AEG's on-site representative providing strategic leadership for the operational and execution of large-scale touring productions. Serving as the senior production representative on assigned tours, this role oversees daily show operations, revenue optimization, and cross-functional coordination to maximize tour performance. The Senior Director partners with artists, promoters, venue personnel, ticketing, and production teams to drive operational excellence while ensuring accurate execution throughout the tour lifecycle.

Essential Functions:
- Lead the day-to-day operational and financial execution of assigned touring productions, serving as the senior production representative with responsibility for production delivery, show settlements, and operational decision-making.
- Drive revenue optimization by evaluating venue configurations, production layouts, and ticket inventory opportunities to maximize sellable seating while maintaining production, safety, and guest experience standards.
- Oversee daily financial settlements, expense management, and accounting activities, ensuring timely reconciliation and compliance with internal financial controls and contractual requirements.
- Coordinate cross-functional tour operations by partnering with ticketing, venue management, production, catering, temporary staffing, and other internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless show execution.
- Provide subject matter expertise and operational leadership by developing best practices, mentoring production staff, and supporting organizational initiatives related to tour operations, financial processes, and production standards.

Required Qualifications:
- Extensive experience managing large-scale touring productions, including live event operations and financial settlements.
- Strong knowledge of production accounting, revenue management, and ticketing operations.

Alpha-9 Oncology is seeking a Director, Program Management to join the clinical team to drive planning and execution across our radiopharmaceutical pipeline. Our programs target solid and hematologic malignancies, and with clinical studies now underway, this role brings the structure that keeps programs on time, in scope, and within budget.

Working alongside our program leads and functional experts, you’ll build and own the integrated plans that connect Clinical, Regulatory, CMC, and nonclinical teams. Program strategy and clinical decisions sit with the program leads. Your role is to frame the options, balance quality, speed, and cost, and guide the team to clear decisions, then make sure those decisions are carried through. This is a hands-on role for someone who digs into the details, raises risks early, and builds trusted relationships across the company to keep work moving.

- Build program timelines and scenarios, mapping the dependencies specific to RLT, such as isotope supply, drug product manufacturing, and imaging agent availability.
- Act as the team’s point person on program risk, identifying issues early and driving mitigation and contingency plans with functional leads.
- Present program status, trade-offs, and options to program leads and the leadership team to support timely decisions.
- Coordinate cross-functional inputs for key milestones, including IND and CTA filings, study starts, and data readouts.
- Run program team meetings, owning agendas, decision logs, and follow-through on action items.
- Establish the program management tools, templates, and processes that scale with the company.

- Connect nonclinical, CMC, regulatory, and clinical plans as programs move from IND-enabling work into the clinic.

- Strong understanding of the drug development lifecycle and the interdependencies across Clinical, Regulatory, CMC, and Nonclinical functions.

About Alta

Alta Resource Technologies (Alta) is a next generation mining company that uses synthetic biology to separate critical minerals from conventional and unconventional resources, including e-waste. Founded in 2023, the company is expanding its team in Boulder, CO. The exponential growth of new tech industries, as well as the information technology sector, are driving historic growth in mineral demand and stressing existing supply streams. Meeting new demand, diversifying the supply chain, and producing minerals in a more sustainable manner requires the rapid development, deployment and scaling of new technologies. This mineral challenge represents a historic opportunity for technology development and value creation. Alta is proud to be at the vanguard of this mega trend.

Alta is seeking a Head of Data Science and Automation to own the data and automation backbone behind our research, development, and scale-up. This is a hands-on, player/coach role at the Director level: you will build and run the systems while hiring, leading, and developing a small team of data and automation engineers.

You will own the data pipelines, laboratory information management (LIMS), Ignition, and the integration of laboratory instruments and process equipment, so that every sample, run, and result across our design-build-test-scale cycle is captured, traceable, and ready for analysis and modeling. Our computational biology team relies on this data to build and refine predictive models, and you will partner closely with R&D, Engineering, and the build, test, and scale teams.

We measure this role by its impact on the business: faster design-build-test-learn cycles, higher throughput, data people can trust, and better decisions that move candidates toward commercialization. You will join a collaborative group of scientists and engineers with diverse skill sets, and bring strong communication, critical thinking, and a rigorous, practical approach to problem solving.

- Build and maintain version-controlled, well-documented data pipelines that bring data from instruments, LIMS, sequencing, and process equipment into a central data platform.

- Deliver analysis-ready datasets to the computational biology team and define with them the data their models need.

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Maritime Division is transforming American sea power to meet the defining national security challenges of our era and secure our future of maritime dominance. We are scaling at an historic pace, anchored by Arsenal-2, our new software-defined shipyard being built in Baltimore County, Maryland. It's part of a new $6.6 billion investment in America's submarine industrial base.

Arsenal-2 is purpose-built to break long-standing industrial bottlenecks and scale production of critical components for the Navy's Virginia-class attack submarines to support fleet requirements. At the same time, it will build the industrial muscle to field our next-generation AUVs at scale.

We aren't waiting for the new shipyard to be completed. The work on this transformation starts right now, with development inside our new 160,000 square foot Proto-Factory in Orange County, California, where the team is already laying the foundation. As the prototyping hub for Arsenal-2, this facility gives us a multi-year head start, proving out the advanced manufacturing methods, digital workflows, and quality systems that will scale across our broader shipyard network.

In Anduril's Maritime Division, we are actively building America's next decisive advantage at sea, and this is the moment to join us.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril Intelligence Systems (AIS) is focused on positioning Anduril as a lead provider of specialized engineering and products for Intelligence Community (IC) customers. We work within the IC to understand their requirements, shape their concepts of operation, and deliver exquisite capability across their problem set. We aim to develop and deploy critically needed capabilities that address our customers' most pressing national security requirements.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a strategic, hands-on leader to stand up and scale our Mission Operations function within AIS. As Head of Mission Operations, you will own the end-to-end operational success of our deployments — building and leading a team of Mission Operations Engineers while establishing the processes, standards, and playbooks that enable repeatable, high-quality delivery across a rapidly growing portfolio of IC programs. This role requires someone who can operate at both the strategic and tactical level: setting the vision for how we deploy, integrate, train, and support our products in the field while remaining close enough to the work to unblock problems in real time.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
- Build & Lead the Team: Recruit, develop, and manage a team of Mission Operations Engineers. Set clear expectations, drive accountability, and foster a high-performance culture rooted in mission focus and operational excellence.
- Define the Mission Ops Playbook: Establish scalable frameworks for system deployment, integration, operator training, and ongoing field support — turning what has been ad hoc execution into a repeatable, measurable discipline.

Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The duty of this organization is to enable our Customers' ongoing Mission Readiness. From the moment they say "go" until the contract is fulfilled. We are only successful when the customer's mission is successful.

Mission Readiness is the post-production shared services organization for Anduril. This team supports the Business Lines and Divisions throughout the lifecycle of their product, from initial sustainment concept through delivery, installation, operation, repair and return. These service offerings also include providing technical publications, training, customer support, connectivity services and other value-added services. To the degree the Business elects, we accept the delegated responsibility for upfront and continued delivery of the committed service solutions. This team endeavors to provide the Business Lines, as our internal customers, shared mission services that are more efficient and cost effective than if they chose to provide them directly. By offering mission support capabilities and capacity that are not "core" to the Business, the Business can focus resources on addressing the next big need while we ensure existing commitments are met.

You will assess where today's pockets of good activity exist, build the roadmap to modernize them, and lead cross-functional teams through the change without slowing down repair turnaround for products already in the field. Apiphani is a managed intelligence provider for complex SAP estates. The company manages SAP environments for enterprises in all industries, with a specialty in compliance-heavy regulated industries, such as aerospace and defense, oil and gas, utilities, industrial manufacturing, and ITAR manufacturing. Apiphani combines its proprietary, agentic-AI driven managed operations platform, Luumen, with a highly skilled operations team to deliver superior human-in-the-loop performance and stability for its customers. This role identifies ideal customers in the GSI and global MSP space, develops executive relationships, positions apiphani’s managed operations value, structures the commercial arrangement, and closes the agreement.

The successful candidate will bring established senior relationships within GSIs or global MSPs, has over a decade of experience in revenue-producing functions – including with alliance partnerships – has a documented record of quota attainment and deep experience driving complex sales to a win.

Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.

As Apptronik scales its humanoid robotics business, we are seeking a Director of Enterprise Security to build and lead our enterprise information security program. Reporting to the Director of IT, the CISO will own Apptronik's risk management and governance frameworks and drive the company toward ISO 27001 certification. This role is focused on enterprise security  protecting corporate systems, data, identities, and SaaS estate. - Establish the enterprise security architecture across cloud for corporate workloads, SaaS estate, and corporate endpoints
